subject: Renewal: procurement portal refresh + tier conversion proposal
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Apr 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal preflight — Cobalt Health (capacity + term change)

Team,

Cobalt Health (see deal DL-2026-0843) is coming up for renewal in July and they want to:
- Move from a 12-month term to a 24-month commitment
- Add ~30% committed capacity (spike to reserved/non-burstable pool)
- Use their procurement portal (Ariba) for PO ingestion + they requested our SOC2 and recent SLAs

Key asks from me: we need a tidy mutual action plan (MAP), a PO split option (initial 6-month deposit + remainder pre-signed), and a clear evidence bundle for their procurement team so onboarding in Ariba is smooth.

I attached a short renewal summary (Cobalt_Renewal_Summary.xlsx) with numbers. Can Marissa take point on collating the evidence for procurement (SOC2 attestation, SLA pdf, SOW v2) and work with Ben on billing options (staggered PO)? Aditya — can you sign off on the tier-conversion / reserved capacity recommendation?

Timing: I told the customer we'd have a MAP and legal checklist by early next week. Meeting with Cobalt scheduled for Thu 4/16 (tentative) — please confirm availability.

Thanks,
Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
pri...@redwood.ai
Attachments: Cobalt_Renewal_Summary.xlsx (spreadsheet, 45 KB)
From: Emma Brown <emma.brown@cobalthealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Apr 2026 10:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Renewal preflight — Cobalt Health (capacity + term change)

Hi Priyom — thanks for the heads up.

Quick context from our side: procurement@cobalthealth.com will handle PO ingestion in Ariba. Their checklist requires: a) SOC2 report or letter; b) signed SOW with committed units broken out by month; c) a PO template they can import (CSV). Finance also prefers not to sign a full 24-month PO up front — they'd accept a split (initial 6-month PO + a second PO for the remainder once terms are signed).

We're definitely interested in the reserved-capacity option for steady latency on our busiest pipelines. Also worth flagging: our security team may ask a short questionnaire — I'll route that once I get it.

Let's keep Thu 4/16 for a 30-min sync. I'll loop in procurement if we produce the MAP and the evidence bundle beforehand.

Best,
Emma Brown
Head of ML Infrastructure | Cobalt Health
emma.brown@cobalthealth.com
Attachments: Cobalt_PO_requirements.pdf (doc, 120 KB)
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 16 Apr 2026 07:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal preflight — Cobalt Health (capacity + term change)

Thanks Priyom + Emma for the context.

Recommendation (high level):
- Offer a tier-conversion plan: convert 40% of current on-demand spend into reserved capacity (guaranteed GPUs per region) across a 24-month term.
- Staggered PO approach: 6-month initial PO at the agreed rate (covers ramp and evidence period), with an automated PO for the remaining 18 months to be issued upon SOW signature. This addresses finance preference while giving us longer committed ARR.
- Evidence bundle: SOC2 attestation + SLA summary + SOW v2 (we should include a short migration appendix for Ariba ingestion).

Marissa: can you draft the MAP template and the SOW v2 by EOD Monday? Ben — please price the 6-month deposit vs full-prepay options and include an itemized billing cadence. If legal wants to limit the PO-trigger language, we can draft an Exhibit A covering the PO split.

Priyom — I can join the Thursday sync at 9:30am PT.

-Aditya
Aditya Rao
Director, Accounts | Redwood Inference
Attachments: none

Date: Thu, 16 Apr 2026 10:40:00 -0400
Subject: Mutual Action Plan + evidence bundle (Cobalt Health)

Emma / Cobalt procurement team — great to e-meet. Per our call, attaching a proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a short checklist of documents we will upload to your Ariba instance. High level MAP below: 

1) Scope & Pricing
   - Redwood to provide SOW v2 with tier-conversion appendix (draft attached).
   - Proposed capacity: +30% committed reserved capacity; 24-month term.

2) Billing & PO flow
   - Customer to issue initial 6-month PO (CSV import) to Redwood; second PO for remaining 18 months to be issued upon SOW signature.
   - We will provide Procurement_CSV_Template.csv to match Ariba fields.

3) Compliance & evidence
   - Attachments we will upload: SOC2 attestation, SLA summary, SOW v2, contact for security questionnaire.

4) Legal & signatures
   - DocuSign link to SOW and Exhibit A (PO split language) to be shared within 48 hours of MAP sign-off.

5) Timeline
   - MAP approval: 3 business days from receipt
   - Evidence upload to Ariba: within 2 business days of MAP approval
   - Target execution: week of 2026-05-03 to enable July cutover

Please review and confirm. I attached Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.docx and Procurement_CSV_Template.csv. If procurement needs any additional fields, let us know and we’ll adjust the template.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Renewals Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Attachments: Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.docx (docx, 28 KB); Procurement_CSV_Template.csv (csv, 3 KB)

Marissa — thanks for the MAP and the template. A few quick notes from procurement: 
- The CSV template looks good but procurement needs a field for internal cost center and a reference for our AP contact. Can you add those columns?
- SOC2 attestation is acceptable; their security team will still follow up with a 12-question questionnaire (small).
- Timeline: procurement has an internal freeze week 4/26, so they want the CSV and evidence by 4/23 to guarantee ingestion before the freeze.

I can confirm a 30-min sign-off meeting on Tue 4/21 10:00am ET — we prefer to have the DocuSign link ready at that time.

Emma
